## Simulations

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
# Set to TRUE for fast testing (fewer grid points, shorter run), FALSE for full publication run
testing_mode <- TRUE

plan(multicore, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 1)

# Parameter ranges
n_pts_main  <- if (testing_mode) 15 else 21
n_pts_joint <- if (testing_mode) 6 else 20   # per-axis for 3D co-optimisation sweep

nitrogen_values <- seq(0.01, 5, length.out = n_pts_main)

# Joint co-optimisation grid (coarser to keep run count tractable)
joint_ecto_allo_values    <- seq(0.0,  0.3, length.out = n_pts_joint)
joint_root_no_values      <- 3*10^seq(3, 6, length.out = n_pts_joint)
joint_root_length_values  <- 1.5 #seq(0.05, 6,   length.out = n_pts_joint)
param_file <- "/home/josimms/Documents/Austria/Plant-FATE/tests/params/p_test_boreal.ini"
weather_file <- "/home/josimms/Documents/Austria/Plant-FATE/data/ERAS_Monthly.csv"
k_mob_N <- new(LifeHistoryOptimizer, param_file)$traits0$k_mob_N

# -------------------------------
# Core simulation function with safe error handling
# -------------------------------
run_sim_parallel <- function(rl, rn, n, eb) {
  tryCatch({
    lho <- new(LifeHistoryOptimizer, param_file)
    lho$set_i_metFile(weather_file)
    lho$set_a_metFile(weather_file)
    lho$set_co2File("")
    lho$set_soil_nitrogen(n)
    lho$traits0$investment_from_tree <- eb
    lho$init()
    lho$root_override(rn, rl)

    dt <- 1/12
    start_year <- 1960
    end_year   <- 2022
    years_seq  <- seq(start_year, end_year, dt)
    
    results <- lapply(years_seq, function(t) {
      tryCatch({
        lho$grow_for_dt(t, dt)
        state <- lho$get_state(t + dt)
        df_row <- as.data.frame(t(state))
        names(df_row) <- lho$get_header()
        df_row
      }, error = function(e) {
        setNames(as.data.frame(as.list(rep(NA, length(lho$get_header())))),
                 lho$get_header())
      })
    })
    
    df <- do.call(rbind, results)
    df$date <- seq(as.Date(paste0(start_year, "-01-01")),
                   as.Date(paste0(end_year, "-01-01")),
                   by = "month")[1:nrow(df)]
    df$root_length   <- rl
    df$root_no       <- rn
    df$soil_nitrogen <- n
    df$ecto_allo     <- eb
    df
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Failed run_sim_parallel: rl=", rl, " rn=", rn, " n=", n, " eb=", eb)
    NULL
  })
}

# -------------------------------
# Helper: safe wrapper for run_sim_parallel
# -------------------------------
run_sim_safe <- function(rl, rn, n, eb) {
  result <- run_sim_parallel(rl, rn, n, eb)
  if (is.null(result) || nrow(result) == 0) return(NULL)
  result
}

pub_cache <- "plots/pub_plots_all_joint.csv"

if (file.exists(pub_cache)) {
  all_joint_df       <- read_csv(pub_cache, show_col_types = FALSE)
  all_joint_df$date  <- as.Date(all_joint_df$date)
  cat("Loaded", nrow(all_joint_df), "rows from cache:", pub_cache, "\n")

} else {
  # -------------------------------
  # Joint co-optimisation: ecto_allo × root_no × root_length × nitrogen
  # n_pts_joint^3 × n_pts_main runs total
  # Parallelised over ecto_allo (outer axis)
  # -------------------------------
  all_joint_list <- future_lapply(joint_ecto_allo_values, function(eb) {
    inner_rn <- lapply(joint_root_no_values, function(rn) {
      inner_rl <- lapply(joint_root_length_values, function(rl) {
        inner_n <- lapply(nitrogen_values, function(n) {
          run_sim_safe(rl, rn, n, eb)
        })
        do.call(rbind, inner_n[!sapply(inner_n, is.null)])
      })
      do.call(rbind, inner_rl[!sapply(inner_rl, is.null)])
    })
    do.call(rbind, inner_rn[!sapply(inner_rn, is.null)])
  })
  all_joint_df <- do.call(rbind, all_joint_list[!sapply(all_joint_list, is.null)])
  dir.create("plots", showWarnings = FALSE)
  write_csv(all_joint_df, pub_cache)
  cat("Saved", nrow(all_joint_df), "rows to cache:", pub_cache, "\n")
}
```

## Co-optimised trait optima

```{r joint_optimum}
# June–August 2021 growing-season mean per parameter combination.
# Rate variables (N uptake, GPP) are zero in winter (f_temp = 0), so January
# snapshots understate uptake; seasonal means give a fair comparison.
joint_gs <- all_joint_df %>%
  filter(as.integer(format(as.Date(date), "%m")) %in% 6:8,
         as.integer(format(as.Date(date), "%Y")) == 2021) %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen, ecto_allo, root_no, root_length) %>%
  summarise(
    height                     = mean(height,                     na.rm = TRUE),
    ectomycorrhiza_mass        = mean(ectomycorrhiza_mass,        na.rm = TRUE),
    ectomycorrhiza_N_biomass   = mean(ectomycorrhiza_N_biomass,   na.rm = TRUE),
    ectomycorrhiza_C_free      = mean(ectomycorrhiza_C_free,      na.rm = TRUE),
    ectomycorrhiza_N_free      = mean(ectomycorrhiza_N_free,      na.rm = TRUE),
    crown_area                 = mean(crown_area,                 na.rm = TRUE),
    lai                        = mean(lai,                        na.rm = TRUE),
    N_bar_roots                = mean(N_bar_roots,                na.rm = TRUE),
    N_bar_myco                 = mean(N_bar_myco,                 na.rm = TRUE),
    C_export_to_myco           = mean(C_export_to_myco,           na.rm = TRUE),
    mycorrhizal_export_to_tree = mean(mycorrhizal_export_to_tree, na.rm = TRUE),
    root_uptake                = mean(root_uptake,                na.rm = TRUE),
    myco_uptake                = mean(myco_uptake,                na.rm = TRUE),
    assim_gross                = mean(assim_gross,                na.rm = TRUE),
    optimal_leaf_nitrogen      = mean(optimal_leaf_nitrogen,      na.rm = TRUE),
    leaf_nitrogen_concentration = mean(leaf_nitrogen_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    tree_nitrogen               = mean(tree_nitrogen,              na.rm = TRUE),
    root_mass                   = mean(root_mass,                  na.rm = TRUE),
    coarse_root_mass            = mean(coarse_root_mass,           na.rm = TRUE),
    total_mass                  = mean(total_mass,                 na.rm = TRUE),
    fineroot_lifespan           = mean(fineroot_lifespan,          na.rm = TRUE),
    total_prod                  = mean(total_prod,                 na.rm = TRUE),
    rr                          = mean(rr,                         na.rm = TRUE),
    tr                          = mean(tr,                         na.rm = TRUE),
    ecm_frac_gpp                = mean(C_export_to_myco / pmax(assim_gross, 1e-12), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

opt_joint <- joint_gs %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
  mutate(
    max_m        = max(height, na.rm = TRUE),
    near_opt     = height >= 0.99 * max_m,
    n_total      = n(),
    n_near_opt   = sum(near_opt),
    stab_frac    = n_near_opt / n_total,
    biomass_gain = max_m / sort(height, decreasing = TRUE)[2] - 1
  ) %>%
  slice_max(height, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()


# --- Stability bands: all combos within 1% of maximum height per soil N ---
# This shows how flat the fitness landscape is around each optimum
stab_joint <- joint_gs %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
  mutate(max_m    = max(height, na.rm = TRUE),
         near_opt = height >= 0.99 * max_m) %>%
  filter(near_opt) %>%
  summarise(
    ecto_lo     = min(ecto_allo,     na.rm = TRUE), ecto_hi     = max(ecto_allo,     na.rm = TRUE),
    ecm_gpp_lo  = min(ecm_frac_gpp,  na.rm = TRUE), ecm_gpp_hi  = max(ecm_frac_gpp,  na.rm = TRUE),
    rn_lo       = min(root_no,       na.rm = TRUE), rn_hi       = max(root_no,       na.rm = TRUE),
    rl_lo       = min(root_length,   na.rm = TRUE), rl_hi       = max(root_length,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

joint_height_range <- range(opt_joint$height, na.rm = TRUE)

shape_vals <- c("Optimal parameters" = 3, "Model output" = 1, "Calculated" = 18)
ltype_vals <- c("Trend line"   = "dashed")

# Produces a 2-row data frame for a straight trend-line segment
tl <- function(x1, y1, x2, y2) data.frame(x = c(x1, x2), y = c(y1, y2))

colour_vals <- c("Stability (≥99% of max biomass)" = "grey70")

shared_scales <- list(
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_vals, name = NULL),
  scale_linetype_manual(values = ltype_vals, name = NULL),
  scale_colour_manual(values = colour_vals, name = NULL)
)

# Fallback: ensures soil_nitrogen x-range is never NA when opt_joint is empty
soil_n_expand <- expand_limits(x = range(nitrogen_values))

stab_label <- geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(stab_frac * 100), "%")),
                        vjust = -0.8, size = 3, inherit.aes = TRUE)

# --- Top row: crosses + stability bars, with dashed trend line ---
p_joint_ecto <- ggplot(opt_joint, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = ecto_allo)) +
  geom_linerange(data = stab_joint, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = ecto_lo, ymax = ecto_hi,
                 colour = "Stability (≥99% of max biomass)"), linewidth = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = "Optimal parameters"), colour = "black", size = 4, stroke = 1.5) +
  stab_label +
  shared_scales +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  expand_limits(y = c(0, max(joint_ecto_allo_values))) + soil_n_expand +
  labs(tag = "A", x = "Soil nitrogen (g N m⁻³)", y = "Optimal ECM C allocation\n(% NPP)") +
  pub_theme

p_joint_rn <- ggplot(opt_joint, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_no)) +
  geom_line(data = tl(0, 3e6, 2, 1e5), aes(x = x, y = y, linetype = "Trend line"),
            colour = "grey40", linewidth = 1.0, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_linerange(data = stab_joint, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = rn_lo, ymax = rn_hi,

  geom_point(aes(shape = "Optimal parameters"), colour = "black", size = 4, stroke = 1.5) +
  stab_label +
  shared_scales +

                limits = range(joint_root_no_values)) +
  soil_n_expand +
  labs(tag = "B", x = "Soil nitrogen (g N m⁻³)", y = "Optimal root number\nper crown area (no m⁻²)") +
  pub_theme

p_joint_rl <- ggplot(opt_joint, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_length)) +
  geom_line(data = tl(0, 5, 2, 1.2), aes(x = x, y = y, linetype = "Trend line"),
            colour = "grey40", linewidth = 1.0, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_linerange(data = stab_joint, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = rl_lo, ymax = rl_hi,
                 colour = "Stability (≥99% of max biomass)"), linewidth = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

r_coarse_root <- 0.04   # coarse root respiration rate [yr^-1], same as rs (sapwood) in p_test_boreal.ini
rr_param      <- 0.4    # fine root respiration rate [yr^-1], rr in p_test_boreal.ini

# --- IQR ribbon across near-optimal combos (≥99% of max height) for panels D–I ---
stab_outputs <- joint_gs %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
  mutate(max_m    = max(height, na.rm = TRUE),
         near_opt = height >= 0.99 * max_m) %>%
  filter(near_opt) %>%
  summarise(
    ecm_lo          = min(ectomycorrhiza_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
    ecm_hi          = max(ectomycorrhiza_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
    ecm_area_lo     = min(ectomycorrhiza_mass / crown_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    ecm_area_hi     = max(ectomycorrhiza_mass / crown_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_mass_lo   = min(total_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_mass_hi   = max(total_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
    height_lo       = min(height, na.rm = TRUE),
    height_hi       = max(height, na.rm = TRUE),
    nroots_lo     = min(N_bar_roots, na.rm = TRUE),
    nroots_hi     = max(N_bar_roots, na.rm = TRUE),
    nmyco_lo      = min(N_bar_myco,  na.rm = TRUE),
    nmyco_hi      = max(N_bar_myco,  na.rm = TRUE),
    cn_lo         = min((ectomycorrhiza_mass * 0.44 + ectomycorrhiza_C_free) / pmax(ectomycorrhiza_N_biomass + ectomycorrhiza_N_free, 1e-12), na.rm = TRUE),
    cn_hi         = max((ectomycorrhiza_mass * 0.44 + ectomycorrhiza_C_free) / pmax(ectomycorrhiza_N_biomass + ectomycorrhiza_N_free, 1e-12), na.rm = TRUE),
    gpp_lo        = min(assim_gross / crown_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    gpp_hi        = max(assim_gross / crown_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_upper_lo    = min(leaf_nitrogen_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),

    n_realised_lo = min(optimal_leaf_nitrogen, na.rm = TRUE),

    n_free_lo     = min(tree_nitrogen, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_free_hi     = max(tree_nitrogen, na.rm = TRUE),
    bga_lo        = min((C_export_to_myco + root_mass * 0.44 / fineroot_lifespan + rr * 0.44 +
                           (r_coarse_root / rr_param) * rr * 0.44 * coarse_root_mass / root_mass) / pmax(assim_gross, 1e-12), na.rm = TRUE),
    bga_hi        = max((C_export_to_myco + root_mass * 0.44 / fineroot_lifespan + rr * 0.44 +
                           (r_coarse_root / rr_param) * rr * 0.44 * coarse_root_mass / root_mass) / pmax(assim_gross, 1e-12), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- Bottom row: N depletion and mycorrhizal economics ---
# Dual y-axis: N_bar_roots (left, black) = mineral pool depleted by roots + myco;
# N_bar_myco (right, steelblue) = organic pool depleted by myco only (f_myco_pool * N_s).
nroots_range <- range(opt_joint$N_bar_roots, na.rm = TRUE)
nmyco_range  <- range(opt_joint$N_bar_myco,  na.rm = TRUE)
# Guard against zero-range (e.g. N starvation makes all uptake values identical)
myco_to_roots <- function(x) {
  dm <- diff(nmyco_range); dr <- diff(nroots_range)
  if (!is.finite(dm) || dm == 0 || !is.finite(dr)) return(x * NA_real_)
  nroots_range[1] + (x - nmyco_range[1]) / dm * dr
}
roots_to_myco <- function(x) {
  dr <- diff(nroots_range); dm <- diff(nmyco_range)
  if (!is.finite(dr) || dr == 0 || !is.finite(dm)) return(x * NA_real_)
  nmyco_range[1] + (x - nroots_range[1]) / dr * dm
}

p_joint_nbar <- ggplot(opt_joint, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = N_bar_roots)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = stab_outputs, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = nroots_lo, ymax = nroots_hi),
              fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_ribbon(data = stab_outputs,
              aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = myco_to_roots(nmyco_lo), ymax = myco_to_roots(nmyco_hi)),
              fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.25, colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 4, stroke = 1.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = myco_to_roots(N_bar_myco)),
             colour = "steelblue", shape = 16, size = 4) +
  shared_scales +
  {
    # Only add a secondary axis when both N_bar series have real variation;
    # a degenerate transformation produces NaN limits that crash patchwork's
    # stats::approx axis-alignment for the right-hand y-axis.
    dr <- diff(nroots_range); dm <- diff(nmyco_range)
    if (is.finite(dr) && dr > 0 && is.finite(dm) && dm > 0)
      scale_y_continuous(
        name     = expression(bar(N)[roots]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")"),
        sec.axis = sec_axis(~ roots_to_myco(.), name = expression(bar(N)[myco]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")"))
      )
    else
      scale_y_continuous(name = expression(bar(N)[roots]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")"))
  } +
  expand_limits(y = 0) + soil_n_expand +
  labs(tag = "G", x = "Soil nitrogen (g N m⁻³)") +
  pub_theme +
  theme(
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(colour = "steelblue"),
    axis.text.y.right  = element_text(colour = "steelblue"),
    axis.ticks.y.right = element_line(colour = "steelblue"),
    axis.line.y.right  = element_line(colour = "steelblue")
  )

  expand_limits(y = 0) + soil_n_expand +
  labs(tag = "J", x = "Soil nitrogen (g N m⁻³)",
       y = "GPP per crown area\n(kg C m⁻² yr⁻¹)") +
  pub_theme

p_joint_n_limit <- ggplot(opt_joint, aes(x = leaf_nitrogen_concentration, y = optimal_leaf_nitrogen)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 4, colour = "black", shape = 16) +
  expand_limits(y = 0, x = 0) +
  labs(tag = "K", x = "Actual leaf N\n(kg N kg⁻¹ leaf)",
       y = "Optimal leaf N\n(kg N kg⁻¹ leaf)") +
  pub_theme

# Free nitrogen pool at maturity: if this is near nitrogen_start0 (0.039 kg) even at low soil N,
# the tree is running off its initial endowment rather than reaching a true N steady state.
p_joint_nfree <- ggplot(opt_joint, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = tree_nitrogen)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = stab_outputs,
              aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = n_free_lo, ymax = n_free_hi),
              fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.039, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  #annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 0.039, label = "nitrogen_start0", vjust = -0.4,
  #         hjust = 0, size = 3.5, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 4, stroke = 1.5) +
  shared_scales +
  expand_limits(y = 0) + soil_n_expand +
  labs(tag = "L", x = "Soil nitrogen (g N m⁻³)",
       y = "Free N pool at maturity\n(kg N tree⁻¹)") +
  pub_theme

make_row_title <- function(label) {
  ggplot(data.frame(x = 0.5, y = 0.5), aes(x, y)) +
    geom_blank() +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = label,
             size = 7, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    xlim(0, 1) + ylim(0, 1) +
    theme_void()
}

# 4-column layout: A-D parameters, E-H mycorrhizal & N depletion, I-L growth & N status
# Stability bands (grey bars) on A-C show the range of params achieving ≥99% of max height
joint_optima <-
  guide_area() /
  make_row_title("Parameters to be Optimised") /
  (p_joint_ecto | p_joint_rn | p_joint_rl | p_joint_total_bga) /
  make_row_title("Model results: Mycorrhizal dynamics & N depletion") /
  (p_joint_ecm | p_joint_ecm_area | p_joint_nbar | p_joint_myco_cn) /
  make_row_title("Model results: Tree Status") /
  (p_joint_height | p_joint_gpp | p_joint_n_limit | p_joint_nfree) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.15, 0.07, 1, 0.07, 1, 0.07, 1), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 30, 5, 5))) &
  theme(plot.tag        = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
        legend.text     = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.key.size = unit(1.0, "lines"),
        legend.position    = "top",
        legend.direction   = "horizontal",
        legend.box         = "horizontal")
joint_optima
```

## Objective function comparison

```{r objective_comparison}
# Net GPP per crown area: GPP minus all N-related belowground C costs, per m2 canopy.
#   rr             = fine root respiration (kg biomass / time unit); * 0.44 = carbon
#   tr             = fine root turnover   (kg biomass / time unit); * 0.44 = carbon
#   C_export_to_myco = C paid to mycorrhiza (kg C / time unit)
# Coarse root respiration excluded: invariant to root_no and ecto_allo.
add_net_gpp_ca <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(
    net_gpp_ca = (assim_gross - C_export_to_myco - rr * 0.44 - tr * 0.44) / crown_area
  )
}

# Last-year snapshot: 2021 growing-season mean (joint_gs already computed above)
joint_gs_lastyear <- joint_gs %>% add_net_gpp_ca()

# Full 12-panel joint-optima figure for any objective column.
# gs_data must contain all columns from joint_gs plus tr.
make_optima_figure <- function(gs_data, var_col, fig_title, obj_label = NULL) {
  var_sym <- sym(var_col)

  opt <- gs_data %>%
    group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
    mutate(
      max_v      = max(!!var_sym, na.rm = TRUE),
      near_opt   = !!var_sym >= 0.99 * max_v,
      n_total    = n(),
      n_near_opt = sum(near_opt),
      stab_frac  = n_near_opt / n_total
    ) %>%
    filter(near_opt) %>%
    slice_max(!!var_sym, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  stab <- gs_data %>%
    group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
    mutate(max_v = max(!!var_sym, na.rm = TRUE), near_opt = !!var_sym >= 0.99 * max_v) %>%
    filter(near_opt) %>%
    summarise(
      ecto_lo = min(ecto_allo,   na.rm = TRUE), ecto_hi = max(ecto_allo,   na.rm = TRUE),
      rn_lo   = min(root_no,     na.rm = TRUE), rn_hi   = max(root_no,     na.rm = TRUE),
      rl_lo   = min(root_length, na.rm = TRUE), rl_hi   = max(root_length, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  stab_out <- gs_data %>%
    group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
    mutate(max_v = max(!!var_sym, na.rm = TRUE), near_opt = !!var_sym >= 0.99 * max_v) %>%
    filter(near_opt) %>%
    summarise(
      ecm_lo        = min(ectomycorrhiza_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
      ecm_hi        = max(ectomycorrhiza_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
      ecm_area_lo   = min(ectomycorrhiza_mass / crown_area, na.rm = TRUE),
      ecm_area_hi   = max(ectomycorrhiza_mass / crown_area, na.rm = TRUE),
      height_lo     = min(height,     na.rm = TRUE),
      height_hi     = max(height,     na.rm = TRUE),
      nroots_lo     = min(N_bar_roots, na.rm = TRUE),
      nroots_hi     = max(N_bar_roots, na.rm = TRUE),
      nmyco_lo      = min(N_bar_myco,  na.rm = TRUE),
      nmyco_hi      = max(N_bar_myco,  na.rm = TRUE),
      cn_lo         = min((ectomycorrhiza_mass * 0.44 + ectomycorrhiza_C_free) /
                            pmax(ectomycorrhiza_N_biomass + ectomycorrhiza_N_free, 1e-12), na.rm = TRUE),
      cn_hi         = max((ectomycorrhiza_mass * 0.44 + ectomycorrhiza_C_free) /
                            pmax(ectomycorrhiza_N_biomass + ectomycorrhiza_N_free, 1e-12), na.rm = TRUE),
      gpp_lo        = min(assim_gross / crown_area, na.rm = TRUE),
      gpp_hi        = max(assim_gross / crown_area, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_upper_lo    = min(leaf_nitrogen_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_upper_hi    = max(leaf_nitrogen_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_realised_lo = min(optimal_leaf_nitrogen, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_realised_hi = max(optimal_leaf_nitrogen, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_free_lo     = min(tree_nitrogen, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_free_hi     = max(tree_nitrogen, na.rm = TRUE),
      bga_lo        = min((C_export_to_myco + rr * 0.44 + tr * 0.44) / assim_gross, na.rm = TRUE),
      bga_hi        = max((C_export_to_myco + rr * 0.44 + tr * 0.44) / assim_gross, na.rm = TRUE),
      cn_exch_lo    = min(C_export_to_myco / pmax(mycorrhizal_export_to_tree, 1e-12), na.rm = TRUE),
      cn_exch_hi    = max(C_export_to_myco / pmax(mycorrhizal_export_to_tree, 1e-12), na.rm = TRUE),
      cexport_lo      = min(C_export_to_myco,                                           na.rm = TRUE),
      cexport_hi      = max(C_export_to_myco,                                           na.rm = TRUE),
      cexport_frac_lo = min(C_export_to_myco / assim_gross,                             na.rm = TRUE),
      cexport_frac_hi = max(C_export_to_myco / assim_gross,                             na.rm = TRUE),
      myco_up_lo      = min(myco_uptake,                                                na.rm = TRUE),
      myco_up_hi      = max(myco_uptake,                                                na.rm = TRUE),
      root_up_lo      = min(root_uptake,                                                na.rm = TRUE),
      root_up_hi      = max(root_uptake,                                                na.rm = TRUE),
      n_return_lo     = min(mycorrhizal_export_to_tree,                                 na.rm = TRUE),
      n_return_hi     = max(mycorrhizal_export_to_tree,                                 na.rm = TRUE),
      total_n_lo      = min(myco_uptake + root_uptake,                                  na.rm = TRUE),
      total_n_hi      = max(myco_uptake + root_uptake,                                  na.rm = TRUE),
      transf_eff_lo   = min(mycorrhizal_export_to_tree / pmax(myco_uptake, 1e-12),      na.rm = TRUE),
      transf_eff_hi   = max(mycorrhizal_export_to_tree / pmax(myco_uptake, 1e-12),      na.rm = TRUE),
      n_deficit_lo    = min(optimal_leaf_nitrogen - leaf_nitrogen_concentration,         na.rm = TRUE),
      n_deficit_hi    = max(optimal_leaf_nitrogen - leaf_nitrogen_concentration,         na.rm = TRUE),
      rr_lo           = min(rr,                                                          na.rm = TRUE),
      rr_hi           = max(rr,                                                          na.rm = TRUE),
      tr_c_lo         = min(tr * 0.44,                                                   na.rm = TRUE),
      tr_c_hi         = max(tr * 0.44,                                                   na.rm = TRUE),
      rr_frac_lo      = min(rr * 0.44 / assim_gross,                                      na.rm = TRUE),
      rr_frac_hi      = max(rr * 0.44 / assim_gross,                                     na.rm = TRUE),
      tr_c_frac_lo    = min(tr * 0.44 / assim_gross,                                     na.rm = TRUE),
      tr_c_frac_hi    = max(tr * 0.44 / assim_gross,                                     na.rm = TRUE),
      all_bg_c_lo     = min((rr * 0.44 + tr * 0.44 + C_export_to_myco) / assim_gross,   na.rm = TRUE),
      all_bg_c_hi     = max((rr * 0.44 + tr * 0.44 + C_export_to_myco) / assim_gross,   na.rm = TRUE),
      ecm_n_free_lo   = min(ectomycorrhiza_N_free,                                        na.rm = TRUE),
      ecm_n_free_hi   = max(ectomycorrhiza_N_free,                                        na.rm = TRUE),
      root_mass_lo    = min(root_mass,                                                    na.rm = TRUE),
      root_mass_hi    = max(root_mass,                                                    na.rm = TRUE),
      frl_lo          = min(fineroot_lifespan,                                            na.rm = TRUE),
      frl_hi          = max(fineroot_lifespan,                                            na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  opt_cn <- opt %>%
    mutate(CN = (ectomycorrhiza_mass * 0.44 + ectomycorrhiza_C_free) /
                 pmax(ectomycorrhiza_N_biomass + ectomycorrhiza_N_free, 1e-12))

  opt_fluxes <- opt %>%
    mutate(
      ecm_frac_gpp   = C_export_to_myco / assim_gross,
      total_n_uptake = myco_uptake + root_uptake,
      transfer_eff   = mycorrhizal_export_to_tree / pmax(myco_uptake + ectomycorrhiza_N_free * k_mob_N, 1e-12),
      n_deficit      = optimal_leaf_nitrogen - leaf_nitrogen_concentration,
      tr_c           = tr * 0.44,
      rr_frac        = rr * 0.44 / assim_gross,
      tr_c_frac      = tr * 0.44 / assim_gross,
      all_bg_c_frac  = (rr * 0.44 + tr * 0.44 + C_export_to_myco) / assim_gross,
      # max_N_transfer cap (k_0=0.2, k_1=0.35, k_8=2.7 from p_test_boreal.ini)
      root_diam_mm   = 0.35 / root_length^0.2,
      SA_tip_m2      = pi * (root_diam_mm / 1000) * (root_length / 1000),
      root_SA_m2     = SA_tip_m2 * root_no * crown_area * lai,
      myco_SA_m2     = 4 * ectomycorrhiza_mass / (1200 * 2e-5),
      age_factor_cap = 1 / (1 + exp(fineroot_lifespan - 2.7)),
      max_N_transfer = 0.033 * age_factor_cap * root_SA_m2
    )

  clean_nan  <- function(df) mutate(df, across(where(is.numeric), ~replace(., !is.finite(.), NA_real_)))
  opt        <- clean_nan(opt)
  stab       <- clean_nan(stab)
  stab_out   <- clean_nan(stab_out)
  opt_cn     <- clean_nan(opt_cn)
  opt_fluxes <- clean_nan(opt_fluxes)

  # x-axis fallback: ensures soil_nitrogen range is always non-degenerate even when
  # opt/stab are empty (all heights NaN → no rows after filter(near_opt))
  sn_expand  <- expand_limits(x = range(gs_data$soil_nitrogen, na.rm = TRUE))

  fn_colour <- c("Stability band" = "grey70")
  fn_scales <- list(
    scale_shape_manual(values = shape_vals, name = NULL),
    scale_linetype_manual(values = ltype_vals, name = NULL),
    scale_colour_manual(values = fn_colour, name = NULL)
  )
  stab_lbl <- geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(stab_frac * 100), "%")),
                        vjust = -0.8, size = 3, inherit.aes = TRUE)

  pA <- ggplot(opt, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = ecto_allo)) +
    geom_linerange(data = stab, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = ecto_lo, ymax = ecto_hi,
                   colour = "Stability band"), linewidth = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Optimal parameters"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    stab_lbl + fn_scales + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
    expand_limits(y = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(tag = "A", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "Optimal ECM C allocation
(% NPP)") +
    pub_theme

  pB <- ggplot(opt, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_no)) +
    geom_linerange(data = stab, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = rn_lo, ymax = rn_hi,
                   colour = "Stability band"), linewidth = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Optimal parameters"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    stab_lbl + fn_scales +
    scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_scientific(),
                  limits = range(gs_data$root_no, na.rm = TRUE)) +
    labs(tag = "B", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "Optimal root number
(no / m2 crown)") +
    pub_theme

  pC <- ggplot(opt, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_length)) +
    geom_linerange(data = stab, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = rl_lo, ymax = rl_hi,
                   colour = "Stability band"), linewidth = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Optimal parameters"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    stab_lbl + fn_scales +
    expand_limits(y = range(gs_data$root_length, na.rm = TRUE)) +
    labs(tag = "C", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "Optimal root length (m)") +
    pub_theme

  pD <- ggplot(opt,
      aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = (C_export_to_myco + rr * 0.44 + tr * 0.44) / pmax(assim_gross, 1e-12))) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = bga_lo, ymax = bga_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Calculated"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) + expand_limits(y = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(tag = "D", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "N-related belowground C
allocation (% GPP)") +
    pub_theme

  pE <- ggplot(opt, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = ectomycorrhiza_mass)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = ecm_lo, ymax = ecm_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_scientific()) +
    expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-6)) +
    labs(tag = "E", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "ECM biomass (kg)") + pub_theme

  pF <- ggplot(opt, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = ectomycorrhiza_mass / crown_area)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = ecm_area_lo, ymax = ecm_area_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_scientific()) +
    expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-6)) +
    labs(tag = "F", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "ECM biomass per crown
(kg / m2)") + pub_theme

  nr_rng    <- range(opt$N_bar_roots, na.rm = TRUE)
  nm_rng    <- range(opt$N_bar_myco,  na.rm = TRUE)
  has_dual_G <- all(is.finite(c(nr_rng, nm_rng))) && diff(nr_rng) > 0 && diff(nm_rng) > 0
  if (has_dual_G) {
    m2r <- function(x) nr_rng[1] + (x - nm_rng[1]) / diff(nm_rng) * diff(nr_rng)
    r2m <- function(x) nm_rng[1] + (x - nr_rng[1]) / diff(nr_rng) * diff(nm_rng)
  } else {
    m2r <- function(x) rep(NA_real_, length(x))
    r2m <- function(x) rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  }

  pG <- ggplot(opt, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = N_bar_roots)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = nroots_lo, ymax = nroots_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out,
                aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = m2r(nmyco_lo), ymax = m2r(nmyco_hi)),
                fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.25, colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    geom_point(aes(y = m2r(N_bar_myco)), colour = "steelblue", shape = 16, size = 3) +
    fn_scales +
    {
      if (has_dual_G)
        scale_y_continuous(
          name = "N_bar roots (kg N / m3)",
          sec.axis = sec_axis(~ r2m(.), name = "N_bar myco (kg N / m3)")
        )
      else
        scale_y_continuous(name = "N_bar roots (kg N / m3)")
    } +
    expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-10)) +
    labs(tag = "G", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)") +
    pub_theme +
    {
      if (has_dual_G)
        theme(axis.title.y.right = element_text(colour = "steelblue"),
              axis.text.y.right  = element_text(colour = "steelblue"),
              axis.ticks.y.right = element_line(colour = "steelblue"),
              axis.line.y.right  = element_line(colour = "steelblue"))
      else
        theme()
    }

  cn_hi <- max(opt_cn$CN, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(cn_hi)) cn_hi <- 1

  pH <- ggplot(opt_cn, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = CN)) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_scientific(digits = 2),
                       limits = c(0, cn_hi * 1.1)) +
    labs(tag = "H", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "Mycorrhizal C:N
(kg C / kg N)") + pub_theme

  pI <- ggplot(opt, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = height)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = height_lo, ymax = height_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-10)) +
    labs(tag = "I", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "Height (m)") + pub_theme

  pJ <- ggplot(opt, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = assim_gross / crown_area)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = gpp_lo, ymax = gpp_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-10)) +
    labs(tag = "J", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "GPP per crown area
(kg C / m2 / yr)") + pub_theme

  pK <- ggplot(opt_fluxes, aes(x = leaf_nitrogen_concentration, y = optimal_leaf_nitrogen)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-10), x = c(0, 1e-10)) +
    labs(tag = "K", x = "Actual leaf N\n(kg N / kg leaf)", y = "Optimal leaf N\n(kg N / kg leaf)") +
    pub_theme

  pL <- ggplot(opt, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = C_export_to_myco / pmax(mycorrhizal_export_to_tree, 1e-12))) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = cn_exch_lo, ymax = cn_exch_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-10)) +
    labs(tag = "L", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "C:N exchange cost\n(kg C / kg N received)") + pub_theme

  # ── Row 4: Mycorrhizal C/N Fluxes ──────────────────────────────────────────

  pN <- ggplot(opt_fluxes, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = ecm_frac_gpp)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = cexport_frac_lo, ymax = cexport_frac_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) + expand_limits(y = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(tag = "N", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "C to ECM\n(% GPP)") + pub_theme

  pO <- ggplot(opt_fluxes, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_uptake)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = root_up_lo, ymax = root_up_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-10)) +
    labs(tag = "O", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "Root N uptake\n(kg N / yr)") + pub_theme

  pO_myco <- ggplot(opt_fluxes, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = myco_uptake)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = myco_up_lo, ymax = myco_up_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-10)) +
    labs(tag = "O", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "ECM N uptake\n(kg N / yr)") + pub_theme

  pP <- ggplot(opt_fluxes, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = mycorrhizal_export_to_tree)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = n_return_lo, ymax = n_return_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-10)) +
    labs(tag = "P", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "N returned to tree\nfrom ECM (kg N / yr)") + pub_theme

  # ── Row 5: N Uptake & Demand ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  pQ <- ggplot(opt_fluxes, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = total_n_uptake)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = total_n_lo, ymax = total_n_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-10)) +
    labs(tag = "Q", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "Total N uptake\n(root + ECM, kg N / yr)") + pub_theme

  pT <- ggplot(opt_fluxes, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = tree_nitrogen)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = n_free_lo, ymax = n_free_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-10)) +
    labs(tag = "T", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "Tree free N pool\n(kg N)") + pub_theme

  # ── Row 6: Root Biomass & Costs ────────────────────────────────────────────

  pU <- ggplot(opt_fluxes, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_mass)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = root_mass_lo, ymax = root_mass_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-10)) +
    labs(tag = "U", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "Fine root mass\n(kg)") + pub_theme

  pW <- ggplot(opt_fluxes, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = rr)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = rr_lo, ymax = rr_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-10)) +
    labs(tag = "W", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "Root respiration\n(kg C / yr)") + pub_theme

  pX <- ggplot(opt_fluxes, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = tr_c)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = tr_c_lo, ymax = tr_c_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-10)) +
    labs(tag = "X", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "Root turnover C cost\n(kg C / yr)") + pub_theme

  # ── Row 7: C fractions of GPP ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  pBB <- ggplot(opt_fluxes, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = ectomycorrhiza_N_free)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = stab_out, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, ymin = ecm_n_free_lo, ymax = ecm_n_free_hi),
                fill = "grey80", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Model output"), colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    fn_scales + expand_limits(y = c(0, 1e-10)) +
    labs(tag = "BB", x = "Soil nitrogen (kg N / m3)", y = "ECM free N pool\n(kg N — bottleneck if high)") + pub_theme

  guide_area() /
    make_row_title("Parameters to be Optimised") /
    (pA | pB | pC | pD) /
    make_row_title("Model results: Mycorrhizal dynamics & N depletion") /
    (pE | pF | pG | pH) /
    make_row_title("Model results: Tree Status") /
    (pI | pJ | pK | pL) /
    make_row_title("Mycorrhizal C/N Fluxes") /
    (pN | pO | pO_myco | pP) /
    make_row_title("N Uptake & Demand") /
    (pQ | pT) /
    make_row_title("Root Biomass & Costs") /
    (pU | pW | pX) /
    make_row_title("ECM N Pool") /
    (pBB) +
    plot_layout(heights = c(0.15, 0.07, 1, 0.07, 1, 0.07, 1, 0.07, 1, 0.07, 1, 0.07, 1, 0.07, 1),
                guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
      title    = fig_title,
      subtitle = obj_label,
      theme    = theme(plot.margin   = margin(5, 30, 5, 5),
                       plot.title    = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
                       plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, colour = "grey30"))
    ) &
    theme(plot.tag        = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
          legend.text     = element_text(size = 14),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.9, "lines"),
          legend.position    = "top",
          legend.direction   = "horizontal",
          legend.box         = "horizontal") &
    sn_expand
}
```

## Yearly GPP-optimal: data wrangling

```{r annual_gpp_wrangling}
annual_gs_all <- all_joint_df %>%
  mutate(
    year  = as.integer(format(as.Date(date), "%Y")),
    month = as.integer(format(as.Date(date), "%m"))
  ) %>%
  filter(month %in% 6:8) %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen, year, ecto_allo, root_no, root_length) %>%
  summarise(
    height                      = mean(height,                      na.rm = TRUE),
    ectomycorrhiza_mass         = mean(ectomycorrhiza_mass,         na.rm = TRUE),
    ectomycorrhiza_N_biomass    = mean(ectomycorrhiza_N_biomass,    na.rm = TRUE),
    ectomycorrhiza_C_free       = mean(ectomycorrhiza_C_free,       na.rm = TRUE),
    ectomycorrhiza_N_free       = mean(ectomycorrhiza_N_free,       na.rm = TRUE),
    crown_area                  = mean(crown_area,                  na.rm = TRUE),
    lai                         = mean(lai,                         na.rm = TRUE),
    N_bar_roots                 = mean(N_bar_roots,                 na.rm = TRUE),
    N_bar_myco                  = mean(N_bar_myco,                  na.rm = TRUE),
    C_export_to_myco            = mean(C_export_to_myco,            na.rm = TRUE),
    mycorrhizal_export_to_tree  = mean(mycorrhizal_export_to_tree,  na.rm = TRUE),
    root_uptake                 = mean(root_uptake,                 na.rm = TRUE),
    myco_uptake                 = mean(myco_uptake,                 na.rm = TRUE),
    assim_gross                 = mean(assim_gross,                 na.rm = TRUE),
    optimal_leaf_nitrogen       = mean(optimal_leaf_nitrogen,       na.rm = TRUE),
    leaf_nitrogen_concentration = mean(leaf_nitrogen_concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    tree_nitrogen               = mean(tree_nitrogen,               na.rm = TRUE),
    root_mass                   = mean(root_mass,                   na.rm = TRUE),
    coarse_root_mass            = mean(coarse_root_mass,            na.rm = TRUE),
    total_mass                  = mean(total_mass,                  na.rm = TRUE),
    fineroot_lifespan           = mean(fineroot_lifespan,           na.rm = TRUE),
    rr                          = mean(rr,                          na.rm = TRUE),
    tr                          = mean(tr,                          na.rm = TRUE),
    ppfd                        = mean(ppfd,                        na.rm = TRUE),
    belowground_infrastructure  = mean(belowground_infrastructure,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    net_gpp_ca   = (assim_gross - C_export_to_myco - rr * 0.44 - tr * 0.44) / crown_area,
    ecm_frac_gpp = C_export_to_myco / assim_gross
  ) %>%
  arrange(soil_nitrogen, ecto_allo, root_no, root_length, year) %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen, ecto_allo, root_no, root_length) %>%
  mutate(height_increment = height - lag(height)) %>%
  ungroup()

# For each year × soil_nitrogen: the parameter combo with the highest net GPP per crown area
annual_opt_gpp <- annual_gs_all %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen, year) %>%
  slice_max(net_gpp_ca, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Joint optima: trajectories over time

```{r joint_optima_trajectories}
# Use actual unique N values from the data so cached results with a different
# n_pts_main don't cause n_low to miss every row in the filter.
soil_N_unique <- sort(unique(annual_opt_gpp$soil_nitrogen))
n_low  <- soil_N_unique[5]
n_high <- soil_N_unique[length(soil_N_unique)]

# Derive trajectory data from annual_opt_gpp (net GPP/crown optimisation, consistent with 16a)
# filtered to the two N endpoints so trajectories show how optima shift as the tree ages.
annual_opt <- annual_opt_gpp %>%
  filter(soil_nitrogen %in% c(n_low, n_high)) %>%
  mutate(
    CN         = (ectomycorrhiza_mass * 0.44 + ectomycorrhiza_C_free) /
                   pmax(ectomycorrhiza_N_biomass + ectomycorrhiza_N_free, 1e-12),
    gpp_per_ca = assim_gross / crown_area,
    N_label    = factor(
      ifelse(soil_nitrogen == n_low, "Low N", "High N"),
      levels = c("Low N", "High N"),
      labels = c(paste0("Low N (",  round(n_low,  1), " g m⁻³)"),
                 paste0("High N (", round(n_high, 1), " g m⁻³)"))
    )
  )

traj_colour2 <- scale_colour_manual(
  name   = "Soil N",
  values = c("#2166ac", "#d6604d")
)
```

## Yearly GPP-optimal: plot function

```{r make_yearly_optima_figure}
make_yearly_optima_figure <- function(annual_data, x_col, x_lab, fig_title,
                                       obj_label = "Objective: max (GPP - C_myco - R_root*0.44 - T_root*0.44) / crown_area per year") {
  x_sym <- sym(x_col)

  dat <- annual_data %>%
    mutate(
      CN             = (ectomycorrhiza_mass * 0.44 + ectomycorrhiza_C_free) /
                         pmax(ectomycorrhiza_N_biomass + ectomycorrhiza_N_free, 1e-12),
      ecm_frac_gpp   = C_export_to_myco / assim_gross,
      total_n_uptake = myco_uptake + root_uptake,
      transfer_eff   = mycorrhizal_export_to_tree / pmax(myco_uptake + ectomycorrhiza_N_free * k_mob_N, 1e-12),
      tr_c           = tr * 0.44,
      rr_frac        = rr * 0.44 / assim_gross,
      tr_c_frac      = tr * 0.44 / assim_gross,
      all_bg_c_frac  = (rr * 0.44 + tr * 0.44 + C_export_to_myco) / assim_gross,
      cn_exchange    = C_export_to_myco / pmax(mycorrhizal_export_to_tree, 1e-12),
      bga            = (C_export_to_myco + rr * 0.44 + tr * 0.44) / assim_gross,
      # mycorrhizal CUE: 1 - maintenance / gross_C  (r_myco=0.5, conversion=2.27 from p_test_boreal.ini)
      gross_C_myco   = C_export_to_myco * 2.27 * 0.44,
      maint_myco     = 0.5 * 0.44 * ectomycorrhiza_mass,
      CUE_myco       = pmax(0, pmin(1, 1 - maint_myco / pmax(gross_C_myco, 1e-12))),
      eff_rF         = 1 / pmax(CN, 1e-3),
      # max_N_transfer cap (k_0=0.2, k_1=0.35, k_8=2.7 from p_test_boreal.ini)
      root_diam_mm   = 0.35 / root_length^0.2,
      SA_tip_m2      = pi * (root_diam_mm / 1000) * (root_length / 1000),
      root_SA_m2     = SA_tip_m2 * root_no * crown_area * lai,
      myco_SA_m2     = 4 * ectomycorrhiza_mass / (1200 * 2e-5),
      age_factor_cap = 1 / (1 + exp(fineroot_lifespan - 2.7)),
      max_N_transfer = 0.033 * age_factor_cap * root_SA_m2
    )

  yr_line <- list(scale_colour_viridis_c(name = "Year", option = "viridis",
                                         guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth  = unit(15, "cm"),
                                                                barheight = unit(0.5, "cm"))))
  pt  <- geom_point(aes(colour = year), size = 1.8, shape = 16, alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE)

  viol <- geom_violin(fill = "grey85", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4,
                      scale = "width", na.rm = TRUE)
  jit  <- geom_jitter(aes(colour = year), height = 0.2, size = 1.5,
                      alpha = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE)

  # ── Row 1: Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  pA <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = factor(ecto_allo))) +
    viol + jit + yr_line +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) scales::percent(as.numeric(x))) +
    labs(tag = "A", x = x_lab, y = "Optimal ECM C allocation\n(% NPP)") + pub_theme

  pB <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = factor(root_no))) +
    viol + jit + yr_line +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) scales::scientific(as.numeric(x))) +
    labs(tag = "B", x = x_lab, y = "Optimal root number\n(no / m2 crown)") + pub_theme

  pC <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = factor(root_length))) +
    viol + jit + yr_line +
    labs(tag = "C", x = x_lab, y = "Optimal root length (m)") + pub_theme

  pD <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = bga)) +
    pt + yr_line + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) + expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(tag = "D", x = x_lab, y = "N-related belowground C\nallocation (% GPP)") + pub_theme

  # ── Row 2: Mycorrhizal dynamics ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  pE <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = ectomycorrhiza_mass)) +
    pt + yr_line + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_scientific()) +
    labs(tag = "E", x = x_lab, y = "ECM biomass (kg)") + pub_theme

  pF <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = ectomycorrhiza_mass / crown_area)) +
    pt + yr_line + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_scientific()) +
    labs(tag = "F", x = x_lab, y = "ECM biomass per crown\n(kg / m2)") + pub_theme

  # When x is N_bar_roots, show N_bar_myco; when x is N_bar_myco, show N_bar_roots.
  # When x is soil_nitrogen, keep the dual-axis N_bar panel.
  if (x_col == "N_bar_roots") {
    pG <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = N_bar_myco)) +
      pt + yr_line +
      labs(tag = "G", x = x_lab,
           y = expression(bar(N)[myco]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")")) + pub_theme
  } else if (x_col == "N_bar_myco") {
    pG <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = N_bar_roots)) +
      pt + yr_line +
      labs(tag = "G", x = x_lab,
           y = expression(bar(N)[roots]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")")) + pub_theme
  } else {
    nr_rng <- range(dat$N_bar_roots, na.rm = TRUE)
    nm_rng <- range(dat$N_bar_myco,  na.rm = TRUE)
    m2r    <- function(x) nr_rng[1] + (x - nm_rng[1]) / diff(nm_rng) * diff(nr_rng)
    r2m    <- function(x) nm_rng[1] + (x - nr_rng[1]) / diff(nr_rng) * diff(nm_rng)
    pG <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = N_bar_roots)) +
      pt + yr_line +
      geom_point(aes(y = m2r(N_bar_myco)), colour = "steelblue",
                 shape = 16, size = 1.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        name     = expression(bar(N)[roots]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")"),
        sec.axis = sec_axis(~ r2m(.), name = expression(bar(N)[myco]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")"))
      ) +
      labs(tag = "G", x = x_lab) +
      pub_theme +
      theme(axis.title.y.right = element_text(colour = "steelblue"),
            axis.text.y.right  = element_text(colour = "steelblue"),
            axis.ticks.y.right = element_line(colour = "steelblue"),
            axis.line.y.right  = element_line(colour = "steelblue"))
  }

  pH <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = CN)) +
    pt + yr_line + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_scientific(digits = 2)) +
    labs(tag = "H", x = x_lab, y = "Mycorrhizal C:N\n(kg C / kg N)") + pub_theme

  # ── Row 3: Tree status ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  pI <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = height_increment)) +
    pt + yr_line + expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(tag = "I", x = x_lab, y = "Height increment (m yr⁻¹)") + pub_theme

  pJ <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = assim_gross / crown_area)) +
    pt + yr_line + expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(tag = "J", x = x_lab, y = "GPP per crown area\n(kg C / m2 / yr)") + pub_theme

  pObj <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = net_gpp_ca)) +
    pt + yr_line + expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(tag = "J2", x = x_lab, y = "Net GPP per crown area\n(objective, kg C m⁻² yr⁻¹)") + pub_theme

  pK <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = leaf_nitrogen_concentration, y = optimal_leaf_nitrogen)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    pt + scale_colour_viridis_c(name = "Year", option = "viridis",
                                guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth  = unit(15, "cm"),
                                                       barheight = unit(0.5, "cm"))) +
    expand_limits(y = 0, x = 0) +
    labs(tag = "K", x = "Actual leaf N\n(kg N / kg leaf)", y = "Optimal leaf N\n(kg N / kg leaf)") + pub_theme

  pL <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = cn_exchange)) +
    pt + yr_line + expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(tag = "L", x = x_lab, y = "C:N exchange cost\n(kg C / kg N received)") + pub_theme

  # ── Row 4: Mycorrhizal C/N fluxes ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  pN <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = ecm_frac_gpp)) +
    pt + yr_line + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) + expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(tag = "N", x = x_lab, y = "C to ECM\n(% GPP)") + pub_theme

  pO <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = root_uptake / root_SA_m2)) +
    pt + yr_line + expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(tag = "O", x = x_lab, y = "Root N uptake per SA\n(kg N m⁻² yr⁻¹)") + pub_theme

  pO_myco <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = myco_uptake / myco_SA_m2)) +
    pt + yr_line + expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(tag = "O", x = x_lab, y = "ECM N uptake per SA\n(kg N m⁻² yr⁻¹)") + pub_theme

  pP <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = mycorrhizal_export_to_tree)) +
    pt + yr_line + expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(tag = "P", x = x_lab, y = "N returned to tree\nfrom ECM (kg N / yr)") + pub_theme

  # ── Row 5: N uptake & demand ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  pQ <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = total_n_uptake)) +
    pt + yr_line + expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(tag = "Q", x = x_lab, y = "Total N uptake\n(root + ECM, kg N / yr)") + pub_theme

  pT_p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = tree_nitrogen)) +
    pt + yr_line + expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(tag = "T", x = x_lab, y = "Tree free N pool\n(kg N)") + pub_theme

  # ── Row 6: Root biomass & costs ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  pU <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = root_mass)) +
    pt + yr_line + expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(tag = "U", x = x_lab, y = "Fine root mass\n(kg)") + pub_theme

  pW <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = rr)) +
    pt + yr_line + expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(tag = "W", x = x_lab, y = "Root respiration\n(kg C / yr)") + pub_theme

  pX <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = tr_c)) +
    pt + yr_line + expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(tag = "X", x = x_lab, y = "Root turnover C cost\n(kg C / yr)") + pub_theme

  # ── Row 7: ECM free N pool ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  pBB <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = !!x_sym, y = ectomycorrhiza_N_free)) +
    pt + yr_line + expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(tag = "BB", x = x_lab, y = "ECM free N pool\n(kg N)") + pub_theme

  # ── Row 8: N transfer efficiency ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  pPhi_CUE <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = CUE_myco, y = transfer_eff)) +
    pt + yr_line + expand_limits(y = 0, x = 0) +
    labs(tag = "ΦA", x = "Mycorrhizal C-use efficiency (CUE)",
         y = "N transfer efficiency\nφ / (U_IN + U_ON)") + pub_theme

  pPhi_rF <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = eff_rF, y = transfer_eff)) +
    pt + yr_line + expand_limits(y = 0, x = 0) +
    labs(tag = "ΦB", x = expression("Effective fungal N:C, "*italic(r)[F]~"(kg N kg C"^{-1}*")"),
         y = "N transfer efficiency\nφ / (U_IN + U_ON)") + pub_theme

  guide_area() /
    make_row_title("Parameters to be Optimised") /
    (pA | pB | pC | pD) /
    make_row_title("Model results: Mycorrhizal dynamics & N depletion") /
    (pE | pF | pG | pH) /
    make_row_title("Model results: Tree Status") /
    (pI | pJ | pObj | pK | pL) /
    make_row_title("Mycorrhizal C/N Fluxes") /
    (pN | pO | pO_myco | pP) /
    make_row_title("N Uptake & Demand / ECM N Pool") /
    (pT_p | pBB) /
    make_row_title("Root Biomass & Costs") /
    (pU | pW | pX) /
    make_row_title("N Transfer Efficiency") /
    (pPhi_CUE | pPhi_rF) +
    plot_layout(heights = c(0.15, 0.07, 1, 0.07, 1, 0.07, 1, 0.07, 1, 0.07, 1, 0.07, 1, 0.07, 1),
                guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
      title    = fig_title,
      subtitle = paste0(obj_label, "\nLines: loess mean of optimal points (shading = SE)"),
      theme    = theme(plot.margin   = margin(5, 30, 5, 5),
                       plot.title    = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
                       plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, colour = "grey30"))
    ) &
    theme(plot.tag           = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
          legend.text        = element_text(size = 14),
          legend.key.size    = unit(0.9, "lines"),
          legend.position    = "top",
          legend.direction   = "horizontal",
          legend.box         = "horizontal")
}
```

## Yearly GPP-optimal: x = N_bar

```{r gpp_xvar_diagnostic}
# Temperature and PPFD are identical across all parameter combinations (same met file),
# so read June-August means directly from the weather CSV and join by year.
met_summer <- read_csv(weather_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(Month %in% 6:8) %>%
  group_by(year = Year) %>%
  summarise(temp_c = mean(Temp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Diagnostic: GPP per crown area vs candidate x-variables to find cleanest relationship
gpp_diag <- annual_opt_gpp %>%
  left_join(met_summer, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    gpp_ca         = assim_gross / crown_area,
    root_SA_m2     = pi * (0.35 / root_length^0.2 / 1000) * (root_length / 1000) * root_no * crown_area * lai,
    myco_SA_m2     = 4 * ectomycorrhiza_mass / (1200 * 2e-5),
    root_up_per_SA = root_uptake  / pmax(root_SA_m2,  1e-12),
    myco_up_per_SA = myco_uptake  / pmax(myco_SA_m2,  1e-12),
    total_n_uptake = root_uptake + myco_uptake
  )

candidates <- list(
  list(col = "soil_nitrogen",             lab = "Soil nitrogen (kg N m⁻³)"),
  list(col = "N_bar_roots",               lab = "N̄ roots (kg N m⁻³)"),
  list(col = "N_bar_myco",                lab = "N̄ myco (kg N m⁻³)"),
  list(col = "leaf_nitrogen_concentration",lab = "Actual leaf N (kg N kg⁻¹)"),
  list(col = "optimal_leaf_nitrogen",     lab = "Optimal leaf N (kg N kg⁻¹)"),
  list(col = "total_n_uptake",            lab = "Total N uptake (kg N yr⁻¹)"),
  list(col = "mycorrhizal_export_to_tree",lab = "N returned from ECM (kg N yr⁻¹)"),
  list(col = "root_up_per_SA",            lab = "Root uptake per SA (kg N m⁻² yr⁻¹)"),
  list(col = "tree_nitrogen",             lab = "Internal tree N pool (kg N)"),
  list(col = "temp_c",                    lab = "Temperature Jun–Aug (°C)"),
  list(col = "ppfd",                      lab = "PPFD Jun–Aug (μmol m⁻² s⁻¹)"),
  list(col = "belowground_infrastructure",lab = "I_b (belowground N factor)")
)

diag_plots <- lapply(candidates, function(v) {
  ggplot(gpp_diag, aes(x = .data[[v$col]], y = gpp_ca, colour = year)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(name = "Year", option = "viridis",
                           guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth  = unit(15, "cm"),
                                                  barheight = unit(0.5, "cm"))) +
    expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(x = v$lab, y = "GPP / crown area\n(kg C m⁻² yr⁻¹)") +
    pub_theme
})

fig_gpp_xvar <- wrap_plots(diag_plots, ncol = 3, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "GPP per crown area vs candidate x-variables (yearly GPP-optimal data)") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
fig_gpp_xvar
ggsave("plots/16a_gpp_xvar_diagnostic.png", plot = fig_gpp_xvar,
       width = 18, height = 18, dpi = 300)
```

## Yearly GPP-optimal: trajectories

```{r annual_gpp_traj}
# For each soil_nitrogen, find the single (ecto_allo, root_no, root_length) combo
# that maximises mean net_gpp_ca across all years, then follow that combo's full
# trajectory — this gives a physically consistent path (no year-to-year jumps).
best_combo_lifetime <- annual_gs_all %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen, ecto_allo, root_no, root_length) %>%
  summarise(mean_gpp_ca = mean(net_gpp_ca, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(mean_gpp_ca, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  select(soil_nitrogen, ecto_allo, root_no, root_length)

traj_gpp <- annual_gs_all %>%
  semi_join(best_combo_lifetime, by = c("soil_nitrogen", "ecto_allo", "root_no", "root_length")) %>%
  filter(soil_nitrogen %in% c(n_low, n_high)) %>%
  mutate(
    CN           = (ectomycorrhiza_mass * 0.44 + ectomycorrhiza_C_free) /
                     pmax(ectomycorrhiza_N_biomass + ectomycorrhiza_N_free, 1e-12),
    gpp_per_ca   = assim_gross / crown_area,
    ecm_frac_gpp = C_export_to_myco / assim_gross,
    N_label      = factor(
      ifelse(soil_nitrogen == n_low, "Low N", "High N"),
      levels = c("Low N", "High N"),
      labels = c(paste0("Low N (",  round(n_low,  1), " g m⁻³)"),
                 paste0("High N (", round(n_high, 1), " g m⁻³)"))
    )
  )

traj_colour_gpp <- scale_colour_manual(
  name   = "Soil N",
  values = c("#2166ac", "#d6604d")
)

# Row 1: lifetime-optimal parameter values (flat lines — fixed for whole trajectory)
p_tg_ecto <- ggplot(traj_gpp, aes(x = year, y = ecto_allo, colour = N_label, group = N_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  traj_colour_gpp + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "ECM C allocation\n(% NPP)") + pub_theme

p_tg_rn <- ggplot(traj_gpp, aes(x = year, y = root_no, colour = N_label, group = N_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  traj_colour_gpp + scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_scientific()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Root number\nper crown area (no m⁻²)") + pub_theme

p_tg_rl <- ggplot(traj_gpp, aes(x = year, y = root_length, colour = N_label, group = N_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  traj_colour_gpp +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Root length (m)") + pub_theme

p_tg_ngpp <- ggplot(traj_gpp, aes(x = year, y = net_gpp_ca, colour = N_label, group = N_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  traj_colour_gpp +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Net GPP per crown area\n(kg C m⁻² yr⁻¹)") + pub_theme

# Row 2: mycorrhizal outputs at the yearly optimum
p_tg_ecm <- ggplot(traj_gpp,
    aes(x = year, y = ectomycorrhiza_mass, colour = N_label, group = N_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  traj_colour_gpp + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_scientific()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Ectomycorrhizal\nbiomass (kg)") + pub_theme

p_tg_ecm_area <- ggplot(traj_gpp,
    aes(x = year, y = ectomycorrhiza_mass / crown_area, colour = N_label, group = N_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  traj_colour_gpp + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_scientific()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Ectomycorrhizal biomass\nper crown area (kg m⁻²)") + pub_theme

p_tg_nbar <- ggplot(traj_gpp, aes(x = year, y = N_bar_roots, colour = N_label, group = N_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  traj_colour_gpp +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(bar(N)[roots]~"(kg N m"^{-3}*")")) + pub_theme

p_tg_cn <- ggplot(traj_gpp, aes(x = year, y = CN, colour = N_label, group = N_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  traj_colour_gpp +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mycorrhizal C:N ratio\n(kg C kg⁻¹ N)") + pub_theme

# Row 3: tree status at the yearly optimum
p_tg_height <- ggplot(traj_gpp, aes(x = year, y = height, colour = N_label, group = N_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  traj_colour_gpp +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Height (m)") + pub_theme

p_tg_gpp <- ggplot(traj_gpp, aes(x = year, y = gpp_per_ca, colour = N_label, group = N_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  traj_colour_gpp +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GPP per crown area\n(kg C m⁻² yr⁻¹)") + pub_theme

p_tg_nlim <- ggplot(traj_gpp, aes(x = year, colour = N_label, group = N_label)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = leaf_nitrogen_concentration), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = optimal_leaf_nitrogen),       linetype = "solid",  linewidth = 0.8) +
  traj_colour_gpp +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Leaf N concentration\n(kg N kg⁻¹ leaf)") + pub_theme

p_tg_nfree <- ggplot(traj_gpp, aes(x = year, y = tree_nitrogen, colour = N_label, group = N_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  traj_colour_gpp +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Free N pool\n(kg N tree⁻¹)") + pub_theme

joint_gpp_traj <-
  make_row_title("Lifetime-optimal parameters (max mean net GPP/crown across all years)") /
  (p_tg_ecto | p_tg_rn | p_tg_rl | p_tg_ngpp) /
  make_row_title("Model results: Mycorrhizal dynamics & N depletion") /
  (p_tg_ecm | p_tg_ecm_area | p_tg_nbar | p_tg_cn) /
  make_row_title("Model results: Tree Status") /
  (p_tg_height | p_tg_gpp | p_tg_nlim | p_tg_nfree) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.07, 1, 0.07, 1, 0.07, 1), guides = "collect") &
  theme(plot.tag        = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
        legend.text     = element_text(size = 18),
        legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines"),
        legend.position = "right")
joint_gpp_traj

ggsave("plots/16c_annual_gpp_traj.png",
       plot = joint_gpp_traj, width = 20, height = 18, dpi = 300)
```

## Stability of the optimum

```{r stability_metrics}
# Compute per (soil_nitrogen, year) stability metrics from the full parameter grid.
stab_metrics <- annual_gs_all %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen, year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total      = n(),
    max_obj      = max(net_gpp_ca,  na.rm = TRUE),
    min_obj      = min(net_gpp_ca,  na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_obj     = mean(net_gpp_ca, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_obj       = sd(net_gpp_ca,   na.rm = TRUE),
    # Flatness: what fraction of combos sits within X% of the maximum?
    stab_frac_1  = sum(net_gpp_ca >= 0.99 * max(net_gpp_ca, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE) / n(),
    stab_frac_5  = sum(net_gpp_ca >= 0.95 * max(net_gpp_ca, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE) / n(),
    stab_frac_10 = sum(net_gpp_ca >= 0.90 * max(net_gpp_ca, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE) / n(),
    # Parameter IQR among 5%-near-optimal combos — wide IQR = insensitive parameter
    iqr_ecto     = IQR(ecto_allo[net_gpp_ca >= 0.95 * max(net_gpp_ca, na.rm = TRUE)],   na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_rn       = IQR(root_no[net_gpp_ca >= 0.95 * max(net_gpp_ca, na.rm = TRUE)],     na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_rl       = IQR(root_length[net_gpp_ca >= 0.95 * max(net_gpp_ca, na.rm = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Curvature: how much does the objective vary across the full grid?
    cv_obj    = sd_obj / pmax(mean_obj, 1e-12),
    obj_range = (max_obj - min_obj) / pmax(max_obj, 1e-12)
  )

# Year-to-year optimal trajectories (already one row per year × soil N)
yy_opt <- annual_opt_gpp %>%
  filter(year >= start_year)

n_col <- scale_colour_viridis_c(name = "Soil N\n(kg m⁻³)", option = "viridis")
pt_n  <- geom_point(size = 1.8, shape = 16, alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE)

# --- Row 1: Flatness ---
pStabA <- ggplot(stab_metrics, aes(x = year, y = stab_frac_5, colour = soil_nitrogen)) +
  pt_n + n_col + expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(tag = "A", x = "Year",
       y = "Flatness (5% threshold)\nfraction of combos near-optimal") + pub_theme

pStabB <- ggplot(stab_metrics, aes(x = year, y = stab_frac_1, colour = soil_nitrogen)) +
  pt_n + n_col + expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(tag = "B", x = "Year",
       y = "Flatness (1% threshold)\nfraction of combos near-optimal") + pub_theme

# --- Row 2: Curvature (sharpness of the optimum) ---
pStabC <- ggplot(stab_metrics, aes(x = year, y = cv_obj, colour = soil_nitrogen)) +
  pt_n + n_col + expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(tag = "C", x = "Year",
       y = "Curvature: CV of net GPP/CA\nacross full parameter grid") + pub_theme

pStabD <- ggplot(stab_metrics, aes(x = year, y = obj_range, colour = soil_nitrogen)) +
  pt_n + n_col + expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(tag = "D", x = "Year",
       y = "Objective range\n(max − min) / max") + pub_theme

# --- Row 3: Parameter spread among near-optimal (5%) combos ---
pStabE <- ggplot(stab_metrics, aes(x = year, y = iqr_ecto, colour = soil_nitrogen)) +
  pt_n + n_col + expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(tag = "E", x = "Year",
       y = "IQR ECM C allocation\namong 5%-near-optimal") + pub_theme

pStabF <- ggplot(stab_metrics, aes(x = year, y = iqr_rn, colour = soil_nitrogen)) +
  pt_n + n_col + expand_limits(y = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_scientific()) +
  labs(tag = "F", x = "Year",
       y = "IQR root number\namong 5%-near-optimal") + pub_theme

pStabG <- ggplot(stab_metrics, aes(x = year, y = iqr_rl, colour = soil_nitrogen)) +
  pt_n + n_col + expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(tag = "G", x = "Year",
       y = "IQR root length (m)\namong 5%-near-optimal") + pub_theme

# --- Row 4: Year-to-year consistency of optimal parameters ---
pStabH <- ggplot(yy_opt, aes(x = year, y = ecto_allo, colour = soil_nitrogen)) +
  pt_n + n_col + expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(tag = "H", x = "Year",
       y = "Optimal ECM C allocation\n(year-to-year consistency)") + pub_theme

pStabI <- ggplot(yy_opt, aes(x = year, y = root_no, colour = soil_nitrogen)) +
  pt_n + n_col + expand_limits(y = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_scientific()) +
  labs(tag = "I", x = "Year",
       y = "Optimal root number\n(year-to-year consistency)") + pub_theme

pStabJ <- ggplot(yy_opt, aes(x = year, y = root_length, colour = soil_nitrogen)) +
  pt_n + n_col + expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(tag = "J", x = "Year",
       y = "Optimal root length (m)\n(year-to-year consistency)") + pub_theme

fig_stability <-
  make_row_title("Flatness: fraction of parameter grid within X% of maximum") /
  (pStabA | pStabB) /
  make_row_title("Curvature: how sharply net GPP/CA drops away from the optimum") /
  (pStabC | pStabD) /
  make_row_title("Parameter spread: IQR of each parameter among 5%-near-optimal combos") /
  (pStabE | pStabF | pStabG) /
  make_row_title("Year-to-year consistency: which parameter combo wins each year") /
  (pStabH | pStabI | pStabJ) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(0.06, 1, 0.06, 1, 0.06, 1, 0.06, 1),
    guides  = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.tag        = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
fig_stability

ggsave("plots/16e_stability_metrics.png", plot = fig_stability,
       width = 20, height = 28, dpi = 300)
```
